item.title: The Honeymoon Murder Of Anni Dewani
item.description: Anni Dewani was murdered during her honeymoon in Cape Town, South Africa, in 2010 after the couple's taxi was hijacked. The investigation drew worldwide attention as suspicion fell on her husband, Shrien Dewani, who was later extradited to South Africa to stand trial. He was ultimately acquitted of all charges, leaving the case one of the most controversial honeymoon murder investigations in recent history.
